'''''MAA FOCUS''''' is the [[newsmagazine]] of the [[Mathematical Association of America]]. It carries news items and short articles of interest to the organization's members.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.maa.org/pubs/focussubmission.html |title=MAA FOCUS — Submission Guidelines|accessdate=January 18, 2009|work=Mathematical Association of America|date=May 5, 2008}}</ref>

==History and profile==
The magazine was first published in March 1981; the first editor was [[Marcia P. Sward]], who held that position until September 1985.<ref>{{cite journal|date=November 2008|title=Marcia P. Sward (1939–2008)|journal=MAA Focus|volume=28|issue=8 |pages=8–9|issn=0731-2040 |url=http://www.maa.org/pubs/nov08web.pdf|accessdate=January 18, 2009}}</ref> Beginning in 2009 the magazine is published six times a year; previously it was published nine times a year.<ref>{{cite journal|last=Gouvêa|first=Fernando Q.|date=January 2009|title=A New Schedule for MAA FOCUS|journal=MAA Focus|volume=29|issue=1|page=11|issn=0731-2040 |url=http://www.maa.org/pubs/jan09web.pdf|accessdate=January 18, 2009}}</ref> The magazine is printed on glossy paper with a final trim size of 8-1/4&nbsp;inches wide by 10-5/8&nbsp;inches high.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.maa.org/pubs/advertising/focus.html|title=Advertising in FOCUS|accessdate=January 18, 2009|work=Mathematical Association of America|date=January 7, 2009}}</ref> Circulation in 2008 was 22,400 copies.<ref>{{cite journal|date=November 2008|title=Statement of Ownership, Management, and Circulation|journal=MAA Focus|volume=28|issue=8|page=18|issn=0731-2040 |url=http://www.maa.org/pubs/nov08web.pdf|accessdate=January 18, 2009}}</ref>
